jit_arm_tcg.assessment: ARM64 JIT is blocked at compile time by the cacheFlush #error (ARM64Assembler.h:4047) and there is no userland cache-flush syscall (kernel __clear_cache exists in EL1, arm/mmu.c:447-458). Exec-mem syscalls themselves are all present (arm trap.c:1792-1804). Under QEMU TCG, I-cache incoherence is not modeled (TCG self-modifying-code detection), so a flush that is a no-op or routed to the kernel would work on TCG even if EL0 dc/ic ops are not enabled (UCI unverified). Cost model: JIT compile is itself emulated guest work under TCG, so for cold script-heavy loads (CNN-class) native LLInt or baseline-with-concurrent-off may beat JIT; DFG additionally needs OS signal delivery (Signals.cpp:29 is OS(UNIX)-gated; OS has no signals, p5-exec-signals-design.md:68-72).
jit_arm_tcg.recommendation: Order: x64 LLInt -> x64 baseline(+DFG probe on KVM) -> ARM LLInt -> ARM baseline gated on the TCG A/B -> ARM DFG deferred until OS signal support (P5.3). Land a SYS_CACHEFLUSH row routing to the kernel __clear_cache (TCG-agnostic) before enabling ARM baseline JIT.
